sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.body: Thank you for your quote. We are prepared to commit to a 24-month term with you — that is worth a great deal to your planning.

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We value our long-standing relationship and appreciate your commitment to a 24-month term, which provides valuable stability for both sides.
However, an extension to 60 days for payment is too far from our standard, so we propose meeting at 45 days.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €51.80 per unit.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Our position
move.body: That commitment is our side of the bargain. We ask one thing in return: your real constraint on price, the number you cannot go below.

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot.
Our terms: a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We cannot disclose our internal cost structures or limits, but I assure you our prices are calculated fairly based on current material, energy, and wage costs.
We have already factored the value of your 24-month commitment into our previous offer.
As your proposed price has unexpectedly decreased, we must maintain our current offer of €52.00 for 60 days payment terms.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.body: We gave you term security; give us the floor number as you would state it to your bank, and we close today.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
As a family-run foundry, our internal calculations and limits remain strictly confidential.
We have already factored the value of your 24-month commitment into our offer and provided a fair price.
Since your proposed price has decreased once again, we must firmly hold our position at €52.00.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
